headline: Todd Blanche rescinds 'anti-weaponization fund'. And, Trump calls off striking Iran
context: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche rescinds President Trump's anti-weaponization fund ahead of his confirmation hearing. And, the president calls off strikes on Iran over a potential deal.
